hypotheses.title: (R/S)-1,3-butanediol extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice
hypotheses.claim: Chronic dietary administration of (R/S)-1,3-butanediol, started in adulthood, increases the median lifespan of genetically heterogeneous UM-HET3 mice of at least one sex.
